rationale: The setup presents a contradictory signal: the stock gapped down ~18% despite a positive earnings beat, implying materially negative forward guidance that overwhelms the headline sentiment—direction from here is genuinely ambiguous. The last five 5-minute candles show extremely compressed range with an ATR of only $0.08, meaning the spread (~$0.06) consumes a disproportionate share of any realistic profit target, eroding edge on either side. With today's realized loss already at -$189 and only $810 of daily budget remaining, the risk/reward does not justify entry into an unresolved post-earnings dislocation with no clear directional mechanical catalyst.
